description: Converts length, mass, volume, time, data, energy, area, speed and temperature using exact definitions (an inch is exactly 0.0254 m). Ambiguous names (oz, gal, pt, KB) return AMBIGUOUS_INPUT with the choices instead of picking one. Reports whether the result is exact or rounded.

rounding.description: rounding rule; default half_up (ties away from zero). half_even is banker's rounding

name: unit_convert
title: Exact unit conversion
